title: bundle-verdict contract data
description: Reference schema (FAFF-819). The SHAPE of the six-value fail-closed verdict `faff bundle verify` computes over a published Phase-0 recovery bundle (CLEAN/STALE/MISSING/MALFORMED/TAMPERED/VERIFICATION_UNAVAILABLE). Shape is normative here; the verdict ladder + exit-code mapping (CLEAN=0, STALE/MISSING/MALFORMED/TAMPERED=1, VERIFICATION_UNAVAILABLE=2) live in bundle.js's classifyBundle. Coercion target for a malformed verdict is VERIFICATION_UNAVAILABLE (never CLEAN) — the review-verdict/quality-gates never-guess-green precedent.

cause.description: A member NAME or status token from a fixed vocabulary — NEVER raw member bytes, a filesystem path, or config content.

superseded_by.description: BundleIdentity | null — populated only when verdict is STALE.
